systems.owner: NIDA, financed by the World Bank/AIIB Digital Acceleration Project
systems.tiers: 7.2 million records scanned and 900,000 indexed across 287 of 418 sectors, as of the mission of 27 October to 7 November 2025
mass enrolment began 28 October 2025 in Gisagara, Huye and Nyanza; about 1.67% of the population registered; system due live to issue credentials by June 2026

note: The only civil-registration statement is the scanning and indexing of existing records, which is archive class and gives no fact; the rest is identity enrolment, connectivity and other e-services.
